blocks.text: # Research notebook — admitted provenance comparative study

**Status:** The current paper record is a bounded mechanism study of artifact admission under version drift. A preregistered Luna R1 experiment and a frozen-protocol three-model follow-up found complete separation on one APEX-derived stale-binding fixture while preserving clean admission; constructed policy fixtures independently reproduced the provenance-triggered recovery path. These results are confirmatory within the frozen harness, not a general product-efficacy estimate. A structured primary-source scoping review is complete, but a reproducible systematic review is not. The evaluation suite remains a benchmark prototype pending independently authored fixtures and independent-environment replication.
**Authors:** Proofpress research team (draft)
**Year:** 2026
**Active substrate:** An information-matched C1/C2 admission comparison on an APEX-derived S-Corp SPA, with clean and injected stale-binding states, plus three constructed policy-revision fixtures. Earlier Artifact Travel, STALE/CUPMem, restricted-access, and HiEviDR-derived records remain separate bounded or diagnostic evidence and are not pooled into the primary claim.
## Artifact map

- `logic/problem.md` — why conventional handoff does not preserve accepted decision state.
- `logic/claims.md` — falsifiable, currently testing hypotheses only.
- `logic/concepts.md` — treatment and measurement definitions.
- `logic/experiments.md` — gates and comparison matrix.
- `logic/related_work.md` — structured primary-source scoping review, closest prior art, and novelty boundary.
- `logic/solution/constraints.md` — non-negotiable fairness and safety constraints.
- `src/` — environment and experiment artifact index.
- `trace/` — append-only decisions and session record.
- `evidence/` — source and sanitized result index, including historical internal MemConflict evidence.
## Abstract (draft)

Agents often inherit an artifact together with prose describing prior work. If the artifact changes, that prose can remain plausible while referring to the wrong version. We study this as an artifact-admission problem. Proofpress adapts established content-binding and policy-based provenance verification to mutable knowledge artifacts exchanged between agents: it records an admitted revision and lets a receiver verify that the artifact currently in hand remains bound to that revision before reusing prior decisions.

In a preregistered APEX-derived document fixture, ordinary handoff continued from stale artifacts in 12 of 12 trials, whereas Proofpress-assisted handoff did so in 0 of 12; both arms admitted all 12 clean artifacts. A frozen-protocol follow-up reproduced the same pattern with GLM 5.2, Kimi K3, and Qwen 3.8 Max. Constructed policy tasks also reproduced deterministic re-verification and grounded recovery, but not a second safety-rate advantage because both arms avoided unsafe policy propagation.

The separation is unusually clean because Proofpress was designed to detect binding mismatch and the primary fixture directly injects that failure. The result therefore shows that native artifact binding controls admission in this harness; it does not estimate how often stale binding occurs, how Proofpress performs on independently authored tasks, or whether it improves general agent capability. A structured review finds close prior work on obsolete memory, agent handoff, cryptographic memory lineage, and software-artifact admission. The contribution is consequently limited to their joint operationalization in an information-matched agent-handoff evaluation; systematic review and independent validation remain open.
## Interpretation and remaining validity work

The primary fixture is mechanism-targeted and design-aligned: its injected fault is the exact condition that the deterministic verifier is intended to expose. Perfect separation is therefore credible as a construct check without being a credible estimate of a broad real-world treatment effect. Cross-model repetition reduces the chance that the result is peculiar to one receiver model, but it does not remove dependence on the shared fixture, prompt, scorer, or harness.

The next evidentiary gate is not more sampling on the same fixture. It is evaluation on independently authored and naturally varying version-drift tasks, including ambiguous lineage, incomplete provenance, benign revisions, and cases where re-verification may impose a false stop or recovery cost. Until that gate and a reproducible systematic literature review are complete, the paper should describe a controlled evaluation suite and mechanism result, not a comprehensive benchmark or a general efficacy result.
## Artifact Travel v3 replication status (2026-08-10)

Artifact Travel v3-r2 is a separately frozen 45-cell successor: 15 package-state
cells repeated three times. It aligns C0, C1, and C2 on one AI Gateway transport,
uses fixed B/R models and reasoning settings, isolates three workers, and
prohibits fallback. The clean contract now treats the tax-counsel item as a
non-blocking post-delivery follow-up; a runnable clean package still requires a
final DOCX. Phase 0 and authorization passed before model calls. The active
formal report is kept in a new resumable results root; two completed cells were
carried from an earlier diagnostic root without rerunning model calls, and only
missing cells are executed. It will be interpreted as a single-case
descriptive replication, never pooled with v2 or promoted to general efficacy.

The completed report contains 44 scorable cells and one invalid C0 receiver
observation. Arm results are C0 clean/end-to-end/fault-safe/unsafe-accept =
0/8, 5/8, 5/8, 0/8; C1 = 0/18, 8/18, 8/18, 0/18; and C2 = 0/18, 7/18,
7/18, 0/18. The invalid observation is preserved as
`receiver-output:receiver selected_artifact must be a non-empty string`.
Provider-level Gateway retries are disclosed as transport telemetry, not as a
fallback arm. Under the preregistered interpretation rule, zero C2 clean
completion stops fault-matrix expansion and prioritizes repair of the runnable
clean handoff and native DOCX task execution.
## Artifact Travel v4 temporal calibration

v4 is the next no-model-qualified protocol, not a reinterpretation of v3.
v3's C1 summary was harness-authored and its C2 carrier was packaged before B,
so its result does not estimate A/B use of Proofpress across time. v4 retains a
sparse ordinary handoff in both arms, gives only C2 a multi-snapshot A trail
and B inspect/import/verify workflow, and keeps R tool-neutral. Its primary
clean outcome is the native per-criterion and `9/9` DOCX result; safe refusal
is scored separately with no DOCX denominator. No efficacy claim is available
until its predeclared clean-path C2 gate is met.
## APEX-direct admission matrix (2026-08-10)

The completed 18-cell APEX-derived SPA matrix isolates a narrower product
claim than prior Artifact Travel runs: whether a successor can admit the
current artifact before doing downstream work. C1 and C2 had byte-identical
ordinary handoff text; C2 alone added a verifiable proof trail. On the
near-current stale-binding fault, C2 correctly reverified in 3/3 repeats;
both C0 and C1 made an unsafe proceed in 3/3. On clean cells, C2 correctly
proceeded in 2/3, versus C1 3/3 and C0 2/3. This supports a bounded admission
mechanism, but not a general downstream-quality claim: native quality among
correctly admitted, artifact-producing clean cells was C1 `4.67/9` (n=3), C2
`5.00/9` (n=2), and C0 `5.00/9` (n=1). The missing clean artifacts are reported
as false rejection or step-limit completion failures, not zeros.

**Correction:** v1 cannot estimate C2 clean admission or downstream efficacy.
Trajectory audit showed that the C2 clean receiver stopped after importing a
receiver-visible harness-only synthetic `capsule.json`, rather than the actual
portable carrier; its `missing_meta` error was therefore induced by packaging.
The observed stale-binding actions remain preserved, but the matrix is now an
operational/fault-mechanism record pending a v2 carrier-only qualification.

The historical MemConflict and completed STALE results remain mechanism boundaries, not product claims. They are not pooled with Artifact Travel v2, whose primary comparison is the full portable package against natural generic continuity. Conversely, the one-case Artifact Travel pilot is not pooled into either historical mechanism record or converted into a treatment estimate.
